simple.summary: חׇפַף (chophaph) means to cover (in protection) First listed occurrence: Deut 33 12.

definitions.full: H2653. chaphaph I. [ חָפַף ] verb enclose, surround, cover (Arabic , surround , side , or border of a thing) — only Qal Participle עָלָיו חֹפֵף Deut 33:12 (poem) he ( ׳י ) is covering him over , figurative of ׳י 's sheltering Benjamin (in temple; on omission of subject see Ges § 116 . 5. R. 3).
